title: Popovers

steps.text: Set out popover/muffin tins - silicone (set on a cookie sheet) are particularly good, don't require grease. Otherwise grease tins.
Make batter at least 2 hours before baking, or the night before, or up to two days in advance. Before using, bring to room temperature and stir again.
Place ingredients in a blender and zap. Scrape down sides and blend again. Can leave in blender until ready to bake.
Adjust oven rack to center-low position and heat to 375. If using metal or glass tins, place them (empty) in oven while heating.
Spray (metal or glass) tins and pan rim.
Fill each cup cup nearly full with batter and bake until popovers are light brown, 45-50 minutes, depending on size. DO NOT OPEN OVEN DURING BAKING.

notes: Savory popovers: add 1/3 cup chopped chives, or some fresh thyme and 1/4 tsp pepper or some lemon zest. Add parsley and Parmesan. Add rosemary and pepper. Add 1/2 cup of grated cheese.
